name: lua_use_player
code:
local scn, done = ...
for _, e in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("prop_physics")) do e:Remove() end
local bot = player.GetBots()[1]
local start, ang = Vector(700, -600, -143.6), Angle(0, 90, 0)
local uses, finds, samples, t, other, crate = {}, {}, {}, -60, nil, nil
local function held(tk)
  if tk >= 0 and tk < 30 then return IN_USE end       -- E on the other bot at 60 u
  if tk >= 100 and tk < 130 then return IN_USE end    -- E on the other bot at 100 u
  if tk >= 200 and tk < 230 then return IN_USE end    -- E on a frozen crate at 60 u (control)
  return 0
end
hook.Add("PlayerUse", "parity_use_player", function(ply, ent)
  if ply == bot then uses[#uses+1] = { t = t, ent = ent:GetClass(), other = ent == other } end
end)
hook.Add("FindUseEntity", "parity_use_player", function(ply, ent)
  if ply == bot then finds[#finds+1] = { t = t, ent = IsValid(ent) and ent:GetClass() or "", other = ent == other } end
end)
hook.Add("StartCommand", "parity_use_player", function(ply, cmd)
  if ply == other then cmd:ClearButtons() cmd:ClearMovement() return end
  if ply ~= bot then return end
  cmd:ClearButtons() cmd:ClearMovement()
  cmd:SetButtons(held(t))
  cmd:SetViewAngles(ang)
end)
hook.Add("SetupMove", "parity_use_player", function(ply, mv, cmd)
  if ply ~= bot then return end
  if t < 0 then mv:SetOrigin(start) mv:SetVelocity(Vector(0,0,0)) mv:SetButtons(0) else mv:SetButtons(held(t)) end
end)
hook.Add("Think", "parity_use_player", function()
  t = t + 1
  if t == -50 then RunConsoleCommand("bot") end
  if t == -30 then
    for _, b in ipairs(player.GetBots()) do if b ~= bot then other = b end end
    if IsValid(other) then
      other:SetPos(Vector(700, -540, -143.6)) other:SetEyeAngles(Angle(0, -90, 0))
      other:Lock()
    end
  end
  if t == 60 and IsValid(other) then other:SetPos(Vector(700, -500, -143.6)) end
  if t == 160 then
    if IsValid(other) then other:SetPos(Vector(400, -200, -143.6)) end
    crate = ents.Create("prop_physics") crate:SetModel("models/props_junk/wood_crate001a.mdl")
    crate:SetPos(Vector(700, -540, -123.6)) crate:Spawn() crate:Activate()
    local phys = crate:GetPhysicsObject() if IsValid(phys) then phys:EnableMotion(false) end
  end
  if t >= -2 and (t < 35 or (t >= 98 and t < 135) or (t >= 198 and t < 235)) then
    local tr = bot:GetEyeTrace()
    samples[#samples+1] = { t = t, hit = IsValid(tr.Entity) and tr.Entity:GetClass() or "", hitpos = tr.HitPos, frac = tr.Fraction,
      bot = bot:GetPos(), eye = bot:EyePos(), other = IsValid(other) and { pos = other:GetPos(), alive = other:Alive(), solid = other:GetSolid(), locked = other:IsFlagSet(FL_FROZEN) } or nil }
  end
  if t == 250 then
    for _, h in ipairs({ "Think", "PlayerUse", "FindUseEntity", "StartCommand", "SetupMove" }) do hook.Remove(h, "parity_use_player") end
    done({ uses = uses, finds = finds, samples = samples })
  end
end)
return "async"
